about: 품질검사요청현황 ○집계 집계조건 3 (E040630) — 2026-10-13 원본 실측: 담당자별 · 품목별 · 월별이면 줄마다 이름을 다 적고 마지막 조건까지 무리마다 '… 계'(깊은 것부터), 끝에 '총합계'. 조건 칸은 채운 수 + 2. 월별 뒤 연별은 순서 안내로 막힌다. QA재고2 요청을 이달 1일 · 지난달 1일(품목 둘)에 넣고 본 다음 지운다.

shots.name: 요청 셋 → 집계 담당자별 · 품목별 · 월별 → 월 계 · 품목 계 · 담당자 계 → 지움
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const it = (await (await fetch('/api/items', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.active !== false); const d = new Date(); const p2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const cur = d.getFullYear() + '-' + p2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-01'; const pd = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() - 1, 1); const prev = pd.getFullYear() + '-' + p2(pd.getMonth() + 1) + '-01'; const mk = async (date, i, q) => (await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ requestDate: date, requester: 'QA재고2', remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: it[i].id, method: 'FULL', quantity: q }] }) })).json()); const a = await mk(prev, 0, 5); const b = await mk(cur, 0, 3); const c = await mk(cur, 1, 2); sessionStorage.setItem('qra3', JSON.stringify({ ids: [a.id, b.id, c.id], n0: it[0].name + (it[0].spec ? ' [' + it[0].spec + ']' : ''), n1: it[1].name + (it[1].spec ? ' [' + it[1].spec + ']' : ''), prevM: prev.slice(0, 7).replace('-', '/'), curM: cur.slice(0, 7).replace('-', '/'), from: prev })); return [a.requestNo, b.requestNo, c.requestNo].join(' / ') })()

js:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qra3')); const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const S = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })) }; S(document.querySelector('input[type=date]'), x.from); await W(1500); const rq = [...document.querySelectorAll('li')].find((li) => li.innerText.trim().startsWith('품질검사요청No.')).querySelector('input'); S(rq, 'QR-'); [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((l) => l.innerText.trim() === '집계').querySelector('input').click(); await W(400); return 'ok' })()
expect:(() => { const t = document.querySelector('table'); return [...t.tHead.rows[0].cells].map((c) => c.innerText.trim()).join('|') === '담당자별|품목별|월별|수량' })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qra3')); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((r) => [...r.cells].map((c) => c.innerText.trim()).join('|')); const i = rows.indexOf('QA재고2|' + x.n0 + '|' + x.prevM + '|5.00'); return i >= 0 && rows[i + 1] === x.prevM + ' 계|5.00' && rows[i + 2] === 'QA재고2|' + x.n0 + '|' + x.curM + '|3.00' && rows[i + 3] === x.curM + ' 계|3.00' && rows[i + 4] === x.n0 + ' 계|8.00' && rows[i + 5] === 'QA재고2|' + x.n1 + '|' + x.curM + '|2.00' && rows[i + 6] === x.curM + ' 계|2.00' && rows[i + 7] === x.n1 + ' 계|2.00' && rows[i + 8] === 'QA재고2 계|10.00' })()

expect:(() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((r) => r.innerText.includes('QA재고2 계')); return r.cells[0].colSpan === 3 && getComputedStyle(r.cells[0]).fontWeight === '700' })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qra3')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const rs = await Promise.all(x.ids.map((id) => fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests/' + id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }))); return rs.every((r) => r.status === 204) })()
